note: Cases for ORB_CONTROL_VALUE_DISCARDED (composition/composed_wiring.rs): a composed trait's rendered value control (std-orb-lint-input's LINT_VALUE_CONTROLS) fires an event it declares with a payload that no trait of the embedder closure (std-orb-embed-chain), no listens route and no other orbital hears and whose own arms keep nothing. Reds: the submission nothing keeps, an internal event, the unread-term search box, the event offered outward (final rule only). Controls: a store routing it, another orbital routing it, an embedder handling it, an arm that reads, persists or shows the value, a persistent entity, a notification, a button, an atom authoring its own form, a guard reading the payload.

findings.message: 'NoteSearch' renders a control that fires SEARCH with a value, but no other trait hears SEARCH and its own SEARCH arm reads none of it - what the user entered is discarded
findings.suggestion: route it to a trait that keeps it: `listens { NoteSearch.SEARCH -> <its input> }` on that trait
